articles.title: From Golf Greens to the White House: Inside Trump's Unusual Grass Fixation
articles.summary: President Trump has mentioned grass at 45 public events in 18 months—more than the war in Iran. His obsession mixes golf-course pride with a controversial plan to pave over much of the White House lawn.

articles.title: The Bank of Mom and Dad: Why More Parents Are Supporting Adult Children in a Tough Economy
articles.summary: Mabel Lago, 70, built a larger retirement home to house her 39-year-old son. A Pew survey finds 80% of Americans say it's harder for young adults to cover basic expenses—and 75% of parents help financially, averaging $7,000 a year.

articles.title: Plagiarism Scandal Rocks Cambridge: University to Overhaul Hiring After Star Professor Quits
articles.summary: Cambridge University will review its senior hiring process after Prof. Jason Arday resigned amid plagiarism and CV-fabrication allegations. A group of academics demands an independent probe, citing 'massive reputational damage.'
